none: PAS LIN-B2ED71: Henig Type VIII silver Roman finger ring inscribed ToT

A silver finger ring, Henig Type VIII, dating to the 2nd-3rd centuries AD. The ring has an oval bezel with the letters ToT inscribed in the centre. The letters 'T' are undecorative and formed by simple lines. The letter 'o' is shown in the lower case. There are two transversely incised lines above and below the inscription.
